visible_text: Question 18: In the figure, $\angle ABD = \angle ADC = \angle BCD = 90^\circ$. If $AB = \ell$, then $CD =$ A. $\ell \sin\theta$ B. $\ell \cos\theta$ C. $\ell \sin\theta \tan\theta$ D. $\frac{\ell \tan\theta}{\cos\theta}$
reasoning: In right triangle ABD, $\tan\theta = BD/AB$ implies $BD = \ell \tan\theta$. In triangle BCD, if $\angle BDC = \theta$, then $CD = BD \cos\theta = (\ell \tan\theta)\cos\theta = \ell \sin\theta$. Therefore, option A is correct.
